metadata.title: Itsy Bitsy Spider
metadata.timing_source: first-pass uniform lyric-line timing from measured master WAV; refine with lyric alignment if needed

cast.lead: small friendly cut-paper spider with round patterned-paper body and thin folded-paper legs
cast.note: PNG folder contains new cut-paper spider/cat references. Alphabet images are ignored. Prompts prohibit text, letters, and numbers.

metadata.compositing: Higgsfield FLUX still generation uses two image prompts per beat: image_prompt_a for frame A and image_prompt_b for frame B. The shot handoff uses one video_prompt per beat that describes how A moves to B. Generate stills only in this stage.
metadata.style: Everything built from layered printed book pages, antique maps, and patterned vintage paper with visible folds and cut edges. Muted teal, slate-blue and bone palette with warm orange-red accents. Soft out-of-focus library-interior background, shallow depth of field, gentle light, soft shadows. Photographed as a tactile pop-up-book miniature, stop-motion animated-film still, handmade, highly detailed. No text, letters, or numbers anywhere in the image.
metadata.prompt_rule: two image prompts for still generation, one video prompt for the shot/motion handoff
metadata.prompt_style_source: User-provided Midjourney examples for B11-B13: tactile pop-up-book cut-paper spider, maple tree, web, warm sun, no text/letters/numbers.
